findings.evidence: `def azimuth (F : AzimuthalFrame) (p : Lorentz.Vector 3) := F.orientation.oangle F.leptonDir (transversePart p)` (line 127); `def relativeTransverse (k P : Vector 3) : E²` (LightFront.lean:332). Every azimuth lemma in the file is a Mathlib `oangle` lemma precomposed with `transversePart`, i.e. the content is `E²`-level.
findings.fix: Define `azimuth (F) (v : E²) := F.orientation.oangle F.leptonDir v` and let the four-vector form be `F.azimuth (transversePart p)` (`φ_h = F.azimuth (transversePart P_h)`). State `inner_eq_norm_mul_norm_mul_cos_azimuth`, `areaForm_eq_norm_mul_norm_mul_sin_azimuth`, `azimuth_negOrientation`, and the zero lemmas at the `E²` level; keep `azimuth_smul_of_pos`, `azimuth_neg`, `azimuth_boost_two` as the four-vector corollaries, where `transversePart` genuinely enters.
findings.issue: `azimuth` is `Lorentz.Vector 3 → Real.Angle`, but the frame datum (`leptonDir : E²`, `orientation`) and all the content live in the transverse plane. Transverse momenta already in the repo are `E²`, not four-vectors, so their azimuth is inexpressible: `Lorentz.Vector.relativeTransverse (k P : Vector 3) : E²` (LightFront.lean:332), the `k_T`/`K_T` of roadmap §0.2, has no azimuth in this API.

findings.evidence: The proof is `refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_; rw [cos_zsmul…, sin_zsmul…, neg_mul_neg]` (lines 241-243) — the `ι`, `s`, `A`, `B` parameters contribute nothing beyond the per-`i` identity.
findings.fix: State the pointwise lemma `A * Real.Angle.cos (m • F.azimuth Ph + n • F.azimuth S) + B * Real.Angle.sin (…) = A * Real.Angle.cos (m • F.negOrientation.azimuth Ph + …) + (-B) * Real.Angle.sin (…)` and derive the `Finset` version from it by `Finset.sum_congr`.
findings.issue: `sum_cos_add_sin_negOrientation` is a `Finset.sum_congr` over a pointwise identity that is never stated. The general result (`A * cos θ + B * sin θ` under the reversed orientation) is buried in the proof, so a caller with one modulation, or with a series that is not a `Finset` sum, cannot use it.

findings.evidence: Line 412: `rw [← add_div_sqrt_two_sub_sub_div_sqrt_two …, ← plusComponent_def, ← minusComponent_def, div_pos_iff_of_pos_right (by positivity), sub_pos]` reaches `minusComponent q < plusComponent q` before `hq` is used in either direction of the `constructor` that follows.
findings.fix: State `inr_two_pos_iff_minusComponent_lt_plusComponent (q : Vector 3) : 0 < q (Sum.inr 2) ↔ minusComponent q < plusComponent q` with no hypothesis, and derive the present lemma from it under `hq`.
findings.issue: `inr_two_pos_iff_plusComponent_pos` carries the hypothesis `plusComponent q * minusComponent q < 0`, but its proof first establishes the hypothesis-free fact `0 < q (Sum.inr 2) ↔ minusComponent q < plusComponent q` (from `q³ = (q⁺ - q⁻)/√2`) and only then uses `hq`. The unconditional form is the natural basic lemma in this `Lorentz.Vector` (PhyslibAlpha-eligible) namespace and is not exposed.

summary: The oriented-angle material is at the right upstream level, but `azimuth` is defined only on four-vectors, so it cannot be applied to the transverse momenta this roadmap layer already produces as `EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)` values; two smaller statements also hide the more general fact inside their proofs.
